label: coach of
definition: The first person coaches or coached the second team or institutional sports program.
scope_notes: Coach-of/possessive and active coaching dominate. Historical coaching is included. Considering a vacancy alone, general management, political participation and athletic participation without coaching are excluded.

facts.reason: Sharing in the Senate supplies no coaching role or sports program relationship.
Pitino is directly called the Knicks coach and actively coaches them. The vacancy/successor language does not remove those explicit historical/general supports.
Parcells is explicitly coach of the Giants and coaches them. A separate leave row is compatible with historical coaching.
Milbury is explicitly the coach of the Islanders.
Thompson is called the Georgetown coach and coaches the institution/program; the program-molding row is consistent.
